Commentary.Commentary: A good game for both teams, in their own respect. South Africa's batting order managed to do well, while Zimbabwe put in an improved performance on the whole. The problem for both remains the same - the batting. It's something they would like to work on before the T20I series starts. The first game begins on 9th October, at 1800 local (1600 GMT). We hope you join in for that. Cheers!

South Africa skipper, Faf du Plessis, says the bowling was really good throughout but the batting was not up to the mark before today. Adds further that the guys are looking good and it is a good sign. States they are always looking ahead and they hope to give everybody a fair run. Mentions that the next tour to Australia is what everybody is looking forward to now. Reckons the last two or three series were very good but by the end of the Australian tour they will have an idea of where they stand.

Man of the Series, Imran Tahir, says he is very pleased with the way he is bowling. Adds further he is trying to improve his game even more and he tries to bowl as he wants to. He feels, since he has been playing regularly he has been able to perform consistently. Mentions it is always good to know what the plans of the selectors are but it is also good if the youngsters get an opportunity. States he is always ready and wants to give his 100 percent whenever he is picked. Ends by saying the 6-fer in the second ODI was the highlight as he did not know he had taken a hat-trick.

Man of the Match, Heinrich Klaasen, says the team played very well. He is enjoying his batting position and thanks Mark Boucher for it. Reckons the wicket was a fantastic one and it has always been fantastic here. Ends by saying he would have liked to be a little more clinical behind the stumps but he enjoyed his work.

Zimbabwe skipper, Hamilton Masakadza, says they weren't good enough in all the three games and there is a lot of room for improvement. Feels they got quite a few starts but they were a few runs short. Adds further that another 50 or 60 runs would have been useful. Credits the way the bowlers bowled. Ends by saying he is looking forward for the T20I series in which they feel they are a better outfit.

In response, on this excellent batting surface, the Proteas' openers got their side off to a positive start which set the tone for the chase. Hendricks and Klaasen got fifties each and that more or less sealed the deal. Admittedly, there were a few hiccups towards the end as the hosts lost some quick wickets, which was largely down to good bowling from Zimbabwe, but never were they in any danger of any sort. They got a good run chase in, so they will be quite happy with that. Stay tuned, as the presentation will be coming up in a short while.

A series whitewash for the Proteas as they win all the three games of the 3-match series. Initially, they got the job done with the ball as they restricted Zimbabwe to 228. Barring Shamsi (who went for plenty of runs) and Duminy, all contributed to the wickets column and broke the back of the Zimbabwean batting order. The Taylor-Williams partnership worth 73 was the only one of any substance, as the rest crumbled, thereby only managing a below par score.

FOUR! And he finishes it off in style! SOUTH AFRICA WIN BY 4 WICKETS! Dale Steyn stands tall to this fullish length ball and hammers it aerially past mid off. No stopping that, it's hit too straight, the ball races away to the boundary line. A good series victory for the Proteas, they win it 3-0. And this is the 10th consecutive loss for the visitors in ODIs.
Pushes this length delivery to cover-point. A slight miscommunication between the two but eventually no harm done.
Big swing and a miss! Length delivery outside off with a lot of room on offer, Steyn throws everything at it only to connect with thin air.
Dale Steyn walks in next.

OUT! Edged and taken! He was hurt on 0, dropped on 0 and caught out on 0 as well. It's the slower one again which does the trick. Angles across a back of a length ball, it's the slower one and Phehlukwayo rises to punch this on the up. Nicks it behind and Taylor dives to his left to take a simple catch.
Zondo waits for the ball to come and cuts it late down to third man for a single.
Tendai Chatara on again.
Straight to the fielder again. Andile drives it square to the man at point. 3 more to win from 30.
On the back foot again, a length ball around off is kept out safely.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Outside off, played to the covers again.

Dropped! Simplest of catches and it's Sean Williams of all people who puts it down. Slower length ball on off, Phehlukwayo doesn't pick it up and as a result lofts it towards Williams at covers. He dives forward low, gets his hands to it but spills it.
Short of a good length outside off, punched through the gap on the off side for a run.
Donald Tiripano is back.
Is not able to pierce the gap yet gain. Driven on the up but to the man at extra cover.
Makes sweet connection but finds the fielder. Phehlukwayo drives it firmly to covers.
Waits for the ball to come and plays it late down to third man for a single.
Outside off on a length, played to point.
Phehlukwayo has taken a blow on his shoulder. The physio is ready to come out but he hasn't yet. Maybe Andile is alright.

Ouch! That has really got to hurt. Zondo tickles this length ball down to fine leg and the batsmen come back for the second. The throw comes in at the bowler's end and Andile gets hit on his left shoulder. He's down in pain instantly.
Length delivery on off, blocked with bat and pad close together.
Tendai Chatara to bowl again.
Angling across on a back of a length outside off, Phehlukwayo leaves it alone.
Andile Phehlukwayo walks out to the middle.

OUT! Klaasen is unable to finish it off himself. Jarvis bowls this short and too slow, Heinrich, as a result, commits to the pull too early. Ends up getting it off the toe end and hands a simple catch to Hamilton Masakadza at short mid-wicket. End of a good knock from Klaasen, he's more or less got the job done for his side.
FOUR! Two in two! Klaasen is looking to finish it off in style. Goes inside out and lofts it cleanly over covers for consecutive boundaries.
FOUR! Bowls it short and pays the price. Short ball, Klaasen is in complete control of this as he stands tall and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Width on offer outside off, a length ball, cut away square to point.
Heinrich walks a step down the track and swipes across the line, only to get it off the inside edge on the leg side.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. One run added to the total. 15 needed to win off 48.
Shortish outside off, kept out off the back foot.
Almost crept through. Short and quicker on middle, Klaasen goes back and just about manages to punch it through the covers for a single.
Fifty for Heinrich Klaasen! His first in this format. Well-deserved too, played so well. He rocks back to this short ball and cuts it past the diving point fielder for a double.
The flipper outside off, punched off the back foot on the off side.
Tossed up leg break outside off, driven to long off for one.
Brandon Mavuta is back.
On the shorter side of things once more, pulled away to deep mid-wicket. Retains strike with the run.
The back-of-the-hand slower one again, short around off, Zondo goes too early with the pull and the ball goes under his bat as a result.
The slower ball from Jarvis, on off, Zondo stays behind the line and defends it with soft hands.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Comes half-forward to this length ball and blocks.
FOUR! He finally scores his first boundary of the innings. Short ball too straight in line, Zondo pulls it through backward square leg to find the fence. Brings up the 50-run stand with that too.
Powerplay 3 signalled. A maximum of 5 fielders will be allowed outside the ring till the end of the game.
Zondo pulls this short ball away into the leg side for a run.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Full ball on the stumps, driven back down the ground.
In the air again... but safe once more. Klaasen lofts the pull over mid-wicket. It goes to the fielder in the deep and a single is collected.
Klaasen lofts it over mid-wicket. Big gap out there, nobody in the deep so a couple of runs taken.
Length delivery outside off, it's run down to third man again for one more.
Powerplay 3 will be signalled after this over.
The batsman guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Short of a good length outside off, punched to the left of sweeper cover. Single to the total.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot straight to cover.
Full outside off, driven to mid off. Another dot.
Fraction straight in line, flicked to short mid-wicket.
Shaping back in on middle and leg, Zondo picks it off his pads and clips it behind square leg for a single.
Kyle Jarvis comes back into the attack.
Hit straight to the man at cover. The Proteas need 32 to win in 12 overs.
Sits up for Zondo as it's served on a length around off, punched through the covers for one.
Length ball on middle and off, punched with the full face of the bat back past the bowler. Mid on rushed to his left and dives to stop it. Single taken.
This full ball is driven to mid on from the inner half.
Rising off the deck as it's landed on a back of a length, Klaasen rises on his toes and blocks it down.
Wide! Banged in short but it's too short, wide signalled by the umpire.
Fullish in length close to off, blocked from inside the crease.
Drinks! Meanwhile, Donald Tiripano returns to the attack.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Another tossed up ball on off, KZ again keeps it out.
Slower through the air on off, it turns a little. Zondo lunges and keeps it out.
A low full toss, it is hit to long off for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Swept and swept fine! Klaasen is into his groove now. He goes down on one knee and sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Another googly on off, Zondo keeps it out.
Picks the googly and flicks it with the spin, through square leg for a run.
Another floated ball on off, Klaasen strokes it to covers.
Cleverly played! Goes down on one knee and sweeps it fine down the leg side for a couple.
Another floated delivery on off, Klaasen strokes it to covers.
Loopy delivery on off, Zondo eases it down to long off for a run. Happy he is with the singles. Not a shot played with intent by Zondo till now.
Brandon Mavuta is back on.
A single to end the over, 5 from it. Zondo taps it towards cover and the batsmen cross over.
Another run as it is eased down to long off.
A little too full on the pads, Zondo flicks it towards mid on for a quick run.
On the off stump, turns away a little, Zondo pushes it to covers.
Flatter on middle, the batter punches it down to long on for a run.
Slower through the air on middle, Zondo with the angle works it towards short fine leg for a run.

SIX! He has picked the bones out of that one! BOOM! Right in his arc, full and on middle, Klaasen lines it up and tonks it over the bowler's head for a biggie. Spoils what was a good over till now. 9 from it in the end, another 49 needed.
Another short ball outside off, Zondo hits it through covers for a run. Singles will do for South Africa.
Fuller in length on off, Zondo strokes it to mid off.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. One run added to the total.
Shortish again outside off, Zondo slaps it through covers for a run. Doing the right thing is Zondo, by rotating the strike.
Back of a length on off, it is guided to point.
FOUR! Make that 13 from the over! A long hop to end, Klaasen has all the time in the world to rock back and pull it over mid-wicket and the ball races away.
Zondo hits it through mid on to give strike to Klaasen. 9 from the over with a ball to go.
And now does the smart thing by working it towards wide mid on for a run. Turning out to be a good over for South Africa.
Klaasen continues the attacking intent as he lofts it over mid on. The fielder is in the ring so a decent connection was enough to clear him. The batsmen take two.
FOUR! That should release the pressure which was building. Klaasen brings out the reverse sweep and hits it through backward point for a boundary.
Zondo with the angle works it towards the leg side for a quick run.
Length again and Klaasen drives it to mid off. Another good over comes to an end, just two from it.
On a length around off, Klaasen, on the up, strokes it to covers.
Shortish outside off, Zondo cuts it through point for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Back of a length on off, Zondo keeps it out.
Drop and run! Klaasen taps it towards point and takes off for a run. The fielder picks the ball up and has a shy at the striker's end but misses.
Tendai Chatara is back on.
Fuller in length on off, Zondo pushes it to covers. End of a successful over for Zimbabwe.
Khaya Zondo is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! The tight bowling has paid dividends here. This is the breakthrough Zimbabwe wanted and Tiripano has provided it. He bowls it very full and around middle, Hendricks tries to flick but misses. It hits him on the pads, the players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Hendricks misses out on a ton and he will be very disappointed. Zimbabwe though are ecstatic as they now have a sniff. 73 more needed with 6 wickets in hand for the hosts.
Slower ball on middle, the batsman works it to mid on.
Trying to make something out of nothing here! Klaasen charges down the track and pulls a short ball but finds the fielder in the deep at the square leg region for a run.
Finds the gap this time through covers and the batsmen change strike.
On a length around off, RH hits it to covers.
Yes, it is one! SW floats this up on off, Klaasen times it to covers. Back-to-back tight overs. A good passage this for Zimbabwe.
5 dots as this one is kept out off the front foot. Maiden?
Now steps out but Williams shortens the length, HK pushes it to covers.
Get itchy here is Klaasen. He brings out the sweep shot but the ball goes off the inner half towards short fine leg.
Tosses this one up on off, the batsman strokes it to covers. A good beginning to this over as well.
Darts it on the pads, Klaasen goes for the sweep but misses to get hit on the pads.

Yes, he can as only a single from the last ball. A tight over, just two from it. They need a few more like this to build the pressure. Full and around off, the batsman times it towards mid off for a quick run.
5 dots now! As Tiripano bowls another short ball on the stumps, Klaasen looks to pull but gets an inside edge onto his pads. Can he end the over well?
Very good bowling! 4 dots in a row now! Again hits the length around off, it has been kept out.
Shortish in length around off, Klaasen stands tall and pushes it to mid on.
Another slower ball around off, the batsman pushes it to mid off. Two dots in a row.
Goes fuller this time around off, Klaasen drives it to mid off.
WIDE! Too short, too high and it has been wided by the umpire.
In the air but it's safe. Hendricks lofts it over the infield. Clears wide mid on and gets two runs as a result.
Uses the depth of the crease to go back and blocks.
Punched away into the off side from the back foot. One run added to the total.
Not much spin on this, nudged in front of square leg. Both take off and Klaasen rushes to the other end to complete the run with a dive.
Hendricks lunges forward to the fuller ball and plays it towards short mid-wicket.
Moves across the sticks to get inside the line and wrists it to square leg.
Sean Williams returns.
Off cutter outside off, placed wide of point and Klaasen calls Hendricks through for a run. Good call.
Moves inside the line and works it in front of mid-wicket.
Length delivery in the off stump channel, defended rather solidly by Reeza.

SIX! First one of the innings. Banged in short, Hendricks takes the pull on and connects well enough, even if it did got off the top edge. It's enough to take the ball sailing over deep backward square leg. The fielder can only watch the ball go over his head.
Tapped down in front of point for a quick run.
Width offered outside off and Tiripano bowls it on a length, hit to sweeper cover for a run.
Klaasen hangs back inside the crease and uses the full face to keep it out.
Wide! Tossed up way outside off, the googly, Reeza lets it be. It's across the other side of the tramline and a wide is called. Taylor can't collect it cleanly and so, the batsmen take an extra run.
Punched off the backfoot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Flat, quick and short, on the stumps, wristed away on the leg side.
Short ball, Klaasen is on the back foot quickly and lofts the pull over mid-wicket. Big gap out there, nobody to take it, so a couple of runs are taken.
Reeza flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Floated up on middle and leg, spinning away, or at least trying to, driven to long off by getting close to the pitch for a single.
Back of a length on middle and leg, Heinrich wrists it wide of the mid-wicket fielder and changes ends.
Full ball in line of the stumps, driven to mid on for nothing.
Slower one, cutting back in and fuller in length. Klaasen works it down on the leg side. Wants the single but then denies it.
Couldn't pierce the gap this time. Full just outside off, it's driven but to the man at short cover.
Slightly fuller on off, Klaasen stays right behind the line and blocks with the full face of the bat.

FOUR! Beautiful. Didn't try to overhit it, just hit it with a lot of 'Klaas'. Full and wide outside off, Heinrich just times this sweetly through the gap in the covers and finds the fence. The required number is below hundred now.
Klaasen is off the mark. He turns this around the corner and keeps strike with a single.
The googly coming in from outside off, Klaasen goes back to punch but is beaten past the outside edge.
Leans ahead and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single this time.
The leg break outside off, driven square on the off side. Won't get any run for it.
Loopy and full outside off, pushed away off the front foot.
Short ball on the stumps, goes back and whips it through the big gap in the mid-wicket region for a brace.
Maiden ODI fifty for Reeza Hendricks! Solid knock so far. He punches it towards sweeper cover and jogs across. He'll want to stay till the end and finish things off.
Short and wide, Klaasen cuts it firmly to the point fielder.
Heinrich Klaasen to bat next.

OUT! Another wicket down, things are getting interesting here. Duminy will be disappointed with this one. Needlessly, he gives the charge to this back of a length delivery on off, JP jumps out to swing hard but gets a top edge which flies over covers. Mavuta out in the deep moves to his left and takes a very good catch diving. South Africa need 107 more runs to win.
Angling across from the left-hander, a length ball, blocked down on the off side.
Tap and run stuff from Hendricks. Places it down towards short third man and quickly gets to the other end. Moves to 49 with that.
Marginally ahead of a length, outside off, tamely pushed to the covers.
Donald Tiripano is back.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Leg spinner on middle and leg, flicked in front of mid-wicket. No run taken.
The wrong 'un on middle and leg, worked away in front of square leg. Single collected.
Duminy uses his feet to get off the mark. Gets close to the pitch and wrists it to long on for a single.
Spinning in from around off, on a shorter length, worked away towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up delivery outside off, drilled through mid off. One run taken.
A nice, tight defensive to end the over. Pushed to mid off and Jarvis just concedes one run in this over.
Shaping away off the seam from around off, Duminy hangs inside the crease and pushes the length ball on the off side.
The slower one on this occasion, full in length once more, JP defensively pushes it in front of covers.
Full ball fired outside off, Duminy drives it to mid off.
In the channel outside off, on a good length, Duminy has nothing to do with it.
Just behind a length on middle and leg, pulled away into the gap on the leg side for a single.
JP Duminy is the next batsman in.

OUT! GONE! The South African captain is dismissed. A bit of a soft dismissal, really. Mavuta drops it short and du Plessis goes back to muscle the pull over mid-wicket. Hits it with power, but doesn't get the desired elevation on it. Towards Craig Ervine it goes, who leaps and takes a sharp catch. Zimbabwe rejoice.
The googly on off, Faf doesn't pick it up as he plays the sweep from the inner half on the leg side.
Pushes this away into the covers. Dot ball.
A lot of air on this one, and seeing this Faf gives the charge before smacking it through towards wide long off. Two runs are easily taken.
Quicker and a touch fuller around off, Reeza backs away and punches it to covers for a single.
Too full and quite loopy outside off, Hendricks misses out as he mistimes the drive square to point.

Drinks are on the field. South Africa are cruising through this chase as their openers provided them with a brisk start. Markram was sent back, but Hendricks and du Plessis are continuing with the fine work. With just 115 needed, you'd have to think it's a matter of when, not if, this match gets over. Also, Brandon Mavuta is brought back on.
Awkwardly done but done nonetheless. Reeza pulls it to deep square leg and earns a single.
Worked away on the leg side and gets to the other end.
FOUR! Sweet as a caramel custard. Smooth. What a shot. Too full and on off, angling in, du Plessis presents a perfectly straight bat as he drives it straight back down and across the boundary line.
Some width offered outside off, smacked through the gap in the covers and the batsmen cross over.
Good length ball quite close to off, Hendricks forces it away towards cover-point. Straight to the fielder.
Another run. The Protea skipper pulls this short ball along the turf and finds deep square leg. One run to the total.
Kyle Jarvis back on.
Some extra bounce as Chatara bangs it short. It rises a bit too much but Faf somehow manages to control the pull down on the leg side. Single to end the over.
Shortish delivery into the body, pulled over the mid-wicket fielder for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
The cutter, full in length on off, driven to mid on by du Plessis. He quickly shouts NO and sends his partner back.
Just behind a length, on the fourth stump line, crunched to covers. Wellington (sub) dives and half-stops it, keeping the batsmen to just the one.
Short of a good length outside off, cut away behind point. A comfortable single results.
Knocks it down to long off and gets to the other end.
Faf skips down the track to block it but is rapped on the pads.
A touch quicker outside off, patted away on the off side.
Floats it up on the pads, it's turned away square on the leg side for one run.
Just behind a driving length, keeps it close to off, Hendricks blocks it from inside the crease.
Short and flat outside off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for one.
Slower one outside off, du Plessis plays inside the line and pushes it behind point for one. 13 from Chatara's third over, 34 in total he has gone for.
FOUR! Shot! Chatara offers width outside off, Faf leans into the shot and hammers it through covers for a boundary.

Caught off a Free Hit! Chatara takes the pace off this delivery and bowls it on a length around off. Hendricks swings it across the line but fails to get enough meat behind his shot. Craig Ervine catches it at deep square leg and releases the ball quickly. A single taken.
Free Hit coming up...
Called a no ball for overstepping! Full and angling back in, du Plessis presents a straight bat and pushes it back to the bowler.
Goes full with his length and angles it in around off, du Plessis flicks it aerially through the vacant mid-wicket region for a run.
A length delivery outside off, punched to deep cover for one.
FOUR! Welcome back into the attack! He bowls a shortish ball around off, not bouncing much, Hendricks swivels inside the crease and pulls it mercilessly to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Tendai Chatara is back on.
Shortish and on middle, hit wide of mid on for another run.
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and eases it through mid off for one.
Flatter and on middle, punched towards mid on where the fielder was quite back and an easy run taken.
Leans forward and pushes it with the spin to covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Pitches it full and on off, du Plessis is forward as he drives it through mid off for a run.
Allows the ball to spin away and then taps it down to point.
Shortish and spinning away, Faf stays back to punch it to sweeper cover. Another run in this over.
Drops it short on middle and it has been pulled to deep square leg for a run.
Quicker and on off, blocked from the crease.
Goes on the back foot and punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Hendricks has played that off the front foot and into the ground. A successful over for Zimbabwe.
Another arm ball, nearly sneaking through. Du Plessis is lucky to get his bat down in time. The inside edge takes the ball to mid-wicket for a run.
Quicker and flatter on middle, turning away, du Plessis is squared up in defense and the outside edge runs wide of first slip for a couple of runs.
Faf du Plessis walks in next. 154 more needed for a run.

OUT! Given lbw! Aiden Markram is mortified with the decision. We will let you know why soon... First coming to the delivery, it's a well-disguised arm ball, landing around off and skidding back in. Markram tries to defend it with a straight bat but misses. He is hit on the pads, they appeal, it looks quite adjacent and the umpire raises his finger. Williams is all pumped up as he has provided the breakthrough. Now coming to why Markram is mortified... Well, there was a big inside edge which was not spotted by the umpire. UDRS is not in practice in this series. Poor Markram departs after getting yet another start.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Flatter delivery, full and outside off, drilled through covers for a single.
Shortish and outside off, Hendricks goes deep inside the crease and punches it to covers.
Full and down the leg side, flicked but straight to mid-wicket.
Rocks back to a shortish ball and punches it down to long off for one.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and flighted on off, Markram plays it with the spin to point and yells no as his partner was interested in a single.
Shortish and on off, stroked from the crease to sweeper cover for a run.
Flatter and on middle, worked to mid-wicket. Dot ball to end a 7-run over.
FOUR! Oh, great shot! Fantastic use of the feet once again by Markram. He rushes down the track and thwacks it over mid off. The fielder in the deep is quite wide and hence a boundary results.
Flatter and on off, probably an arm ball, Aiden blocks it from the crease.
Lunges to a full ball and drives it through covers for one.
Goes on the back foot and punches it down to long off for a single.
Tickles it off his pads through square leg for a run.
Powerplay 2 time! A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over. Sean Williams to continue.
Loopy and on off, blocked off the front foot. End of Powerplay 1, South Africa are cruising currently.
On the pads, eased in the gap on the leg side for a single.
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and strokes it through mid off for a run.
Pulls his length back a bit and bowls it on middle, Hendricks moves back and turns it through square leg for one.
Tossed up ball outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Great shot! Full floated ball on off, Hendricks attacks it with all his might and pumps it over extra cover for a boundary.
Skidding on the pads again, helped in the gap between square leg and fine leg for one.
Full and on middle, clipped to square leg for a run.
FOUR! Excellent footwork by Aiden Markram. He jumps out of the crease to reach the pitch of the ball and then powers it over mid on for a boundary.
Markram has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flatter on off, punched off the back foot to covers.
A mistimed shot! Flighted and full outside off, Markram goes hard at it and hits it in the air over cover-point. A couple taken. 50-run stand comes up!
Spin from both ends. Sean Williams to roll his arm now.
Quicker and off, defended off the back foot by Hendricks. A pretty ordinary beginning by Mavuta. 7 off his first over.
FOUR! Too short by Mavuta this time, he lands it on middle and Hendricks plays a cracking pull shot over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full and flighted on off, defended off the front foot to the off side.
Short and outside off, cut from the back foot but straight to point.
A slider, down the leg side, Hendricks fails to get bat on ball. Called a wide.
Tossed up ball on middle, bowled with a high-arm action, Reeza defends it from the back foot.
Wide! Loopy and full but down the leg side, Hendricks fails to flick and it's good take by Taylor.
Starts with a shorter delivery outside off, it's punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a run.
Brandon Mavuta to bowl his leggies. He was very impressive in the last match and Zimbabwe would be hoping for a similar performance from him today. Let's see how he delivers...
Keeps his line around off, Hendricks gets behind the delivery properly before pushing it towards mid off.
Straighter in line this time, on a good length, Hendricks picks it off his pads and flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Shortish and on off, punched again but this time straight to mid off.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Reeza delays his punch shot a bit so that he can find the gap past the point fielder. He does so well and collects a couple of runs.
Angles in a length ball on off, Hendricks pushes it out from the crease to covers.
A good length ball on off, defended off the back foot.
Pushes it towards mid on.
Pushes it towards mid on.
On middle and leg, flicked away for a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
FOUR! The boundaries continue to flow. A short ball around off, Hendricks pulls it behind square leg.
Full and down the leg side, tickled towards square leg for a single.
Donald Tiripano to bowl.
Again on the pads and Reeza again accepts the gift and flicks it through square leg for a brace.
A bit fuller this time on off, an off cutter, the batsman is early into his shot and drags the ball into the mid-wicket region to get a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Fires it on the pads again and a player of Markram's quality will not miss many times, he whips it through mid-wicket to get a brace.
Aiden defends it from within the crease.
Rapped on the thigh-pad but too high, a short of a good length ball angling into the batsman, Markram tries to flick it but misses.
Aiden plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man to retain strike.
A bit shorter of good length, Markram tries to cut but gets a bottom edge onto the ground.
FOUR! Just not learning, the Zimbabwe bowlers. Again a short and wide ball outside off, asking the batsman to smash it through point and the batsman obliges.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full on off, played through mid-wicket by the batsman.

FOUR! Cracked! Not good this from Zimbabwe. First time in this series their batsmen have been able to put up a decent score on the board but the bowlers are letting them down with such a start. Short and wide of off, cut fiercely through point for a boundary.
A bit shorter in length around off, punched straight to the man at cover-point.
Good bowling this by Jarvis as he keeps it on a good length around off, Reeza keeps it out off the back foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

FOUR! Pure timing! A fractionally back of a length ball around the batsman's hips, Markram just whips it nonchalantly through square leg, the timing is so good that the fielder chasing it cannot stop it from crossing the fence. South Africa off to a superb start.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover.
FOUR! A very bad start from Chatara and Zimbabwe, just what they did not want. Again on the pads and flicked through mid-wicket for the third boundary to end the over.

FOUR! Chatara has not learned from his mistake on the third ball as he dishes out a full ball again on the batsman's pads, Aiden this time flicks it uppishly but into the gap at square leg to get a boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! First boundary of the innings as Chatara errs in his line and strays a full ball on Markram's pads. Aiden flicks it through square leg for a boundary.
A good length ball around off stump, Markram blocks it from within the crease.
Markram has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tendai Chatara to share the attack with the second new ball.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Hendricks misses out as he cuts this shorter and wide of off ball straight to point.
Wide! Way down the leg side, first extra of the innings conceded.
Good away movement on landing but a bit outside off, Hendricks shoulders arms.
Strays on his pads and Markram tucks it to fine leg to get himself and his team off the mark.
Similar length but wide of off, left alone.
Starts with a marginally shorter than good length delivery, Markram keeps it out from the crease.

Time for the chase to begin. Reeza Hendricks and Aiden Markram stride out to the centre to open for South Africa. For the visitors, it's going to be Kyle Jarvis to kickoff proceedings with the first new ball.
